svg.title: Get your bicycle moving again — Customer journey — Current state · AS-IS
svg.desc: Bicycle repair: main path and declined estimate · Need for repair → Collection after repair or return without repair · As of: 2026-09-06. Fictional service. Actions come from an authored brief; experiences and barriers are hypotheses, improvements are proposals.

g.aria-label: Repair needed
Repair needed. Customer goal: Find where to get help. Stated in source
Booking. Customer goal: Choose a convenient time. Stated in source
Drop-off. Customer goal: Hand over the bicycle with confidence. Stated in source
Approval. Customer goal: Understand the work and its price. Stated in source
Repair. Customer goal: Wait for the bicycle to be ready. Stated in source
Collection. Customer goal: Leave with a working bicycle. Stated in source
Repair needed. Action & channel: Describes the fault. Stated in source
Booking. Action & channel: Confirms the visit. Stated in source
Drop-off. Action & channel: Brings the bicycle in. Stated in source
Approval. Action & channel: Approves or declines the estimate. Stated in source
Repair. Action & channel: Waits for notification. Stated in source
Collection. Action & channel: Checks the work and collects. Stated in source
Repair needed. Experience: I don’t know how long this will take. Hypothesis
Booking. Experience: I want to plan my day. Hypothesis

text.tspan: I want to plan my day

g.aria-label: Drop-off. Experience: I want to know what they accepted. Hypothesis
Approval. Experience: I want to understand what I’m paying for. Hypothesis
Repair. Experience: I don’t know what is happening now. Hypothesis
Collection. Experience: I want confidence in the result. Hypothesis
Repair needed. Barrier: Response time is not stated. Hypothesis
Booking. Barrier: Booking requires a phone call. Hypothesis
Drop-off. Barrier: No date for the next contact at drop-off. Hypothesis
Approval. Barrier: Work waits for the customer’s reply. Hypothesis
Repair. Barrier: No progress update during repair. Hypothesis
Collection. Barrier: Unclear how to ask follow-up questions. Hypothesis
Repair needed. Improvement: Show response time beside the form. Proposal
Booking. Improvement: Offer a choice of available times. Proposal
Drop-off. Improvement: State the diagnosis timeline at drop-off. Proposal
Approval. Improvement: Send an estimate with clear choices. Proposal
Repair. Improvement: Show the current step and delays. Proposal
Collection. Improvement: Provide a clear contact for questions. Proposal
